dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable flags preserve order and reject incompatible combinations; baseline behavior remains on the no-selection path. Help lacks a repeated-field example.
evidence: product.diff: StringArrayVar additions and resolveSelectedFields loop

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Name resolution is case-insensitive, returns canonical ProjectField headers, provides sorted candidates, and sorts ambiguous IDs.
evidence: tests.log: focused Go test command exits 0

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: The item query already fetches first-page fields; remaining pages are fetched only when PageInfo requires it, and errors return before rendering.
evidence: product.diff: RemainingProjectFields returns initial nodes when no next page and paginates otherwise
tests.log: focused Go test command exits 0

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All specified scalar, structured, and collection value types render to human-readable cells; unknown/missing values are empty and CR/LF is normalized.
evidence: product.diff: itemFieldValue returns empty when no matching field ID
product.diff: item_list_fields_test.go rendering and normalization tests

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Selected fields generate ordered headers and one cell per selected field for every item; lookup is by field node ID, so missing values cannot shift later columns.
evidence: product.diff: itemFieldValue compares value.ID() with selected field.ID()

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Field retrieval and resolution complete before table rendering; pagination failures propagate and the focused test confirms stdout remains empty. The change reuses established query and table helpers.
